rules.expected: Check the supplied Group A graph, full stoichiometry, source terminal-H convention, atom mapping and actual Au111 lead/contact/central-region definitions. Verify charge and occupation consistently for an open system. Different geometries are permitted research choices; quantify whether their differences confound any bridge-only claim. Do not require a fixed Au atom count or predefined contact perturbation. Read actual submitted files and tool provenance, resolve identifiers and recompute the quantities supporting the claim. No old scalar target or universal uncalibrated tolerance applies. Missing evidence cannot be scored as an indistinguishable result. Judge alternative valid routes by the same scientific standard, not by agreement with the author or completion of a private reference matrix. Award full criterion credit only when its substantive claim is supported over its stated domain; partial credit requires independently valid evidence and explicit missing coverage. Award no credit to the affected claim when essential identity, validity or evidence is absent; fluent explanation does not repair it. These are judgment anchors, not a calibrated numerical equivalence threshold.

scientific_rubric.description: Well-defined and comparable molecular junction objects

scoring_boundary: Offline schema/artifact validation does not certify scientific conclusions. Exact or broad numerical equivalence requires reference-specific justification; no blanket tolerance. Credit independent valid parts, but invalidate dependent claims when their evidence fails. Operator-caused missing mandatory public input is a task prerequisite defect: exclude such a run from agent capability comparisons rather than assigning a low science score for the unavailable input. Package disposition is an operator instruction, not an implemented host dispatch gate.
